subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar o passado simples e o passado contínuo para produzir textos orais e escritos, mostrando relações de sequência e causalidade.

components.description_pt: Usar passado simples para expressar ações completas e eventos sequenciais em textos orais e escritos
components.description_en: Use the simple past to express completed actions and sequential events in oral and written texts
components.cc_component_description: Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs

components.description_pt: Usar tempo passado progressivo para descrever ações passadas contínuas na escrita
components.description_en: Use past progressive tense to describe ongoing past actions in writing
components.cc_component_description: Use past progressive tense to describe ongoing past actions in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre passado simples e passado contínuo para expressar relações de sequência e causalidade
components.description_en: Distinguish between the simple past and past continuous to express relationships of sequence and causality
components.cc_component_description: Use correct verb tense to convey time, sequence, and condition in writing or speaking

cc_matches.description: Form and use the progressive (e.g., I was walking; I am walking; I will be walking) verb tenses.
